description: This file defines the AdmonitionParser class, which is responsible for parsing 'admonition' blocks in Markdown content. It extends the AbstractBlockContinueParser and implements BlockContinueParserWithInlinesInterface, handling the detection and parsing of admonition directives (e.g., !!! note) within Markdown documents, including nested content and optional titles.

classes.name: AdmonitionParser
classes.description: A parser class for handling admonition blocks within Markdown content, capable of recognizing specific admonition directives and managing their inline content and structure.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of AdmonitionParser with a specified type and optional title.

methods.name: getBlock
methods.description: Returns the current AdmonitionBlock associated with this parser.

methods.name: isContainer
methods.description: Indicates that this block can contain other blocks.

methods.name: canContain
methods.description: Determines if this block can contain the specified child block.

methods.name: tryContinue
methods.description: Determines whether parsing should continue based on the cursor position, supporting indented and blank lines.

methods.name: blockStartParser
methods.description: Provides a static method to create a block start parser that recognizes admonition directives in Markdown.

methods.name: parseInlines
methods.description: Parses inline content within the admonition, particularly the title if present.
